lines: I've got the perfect thing for their numbers...! Haa-aaaaaaaaaagh!
Kirara-senpai plunged directly into the horde of more than 30 enemies as she charged her cold air.
It was far too reckless no matter how you look at it. I instinctively called out, but...
Fuma! Stay where you are if you don't wanna get caught in this!
Just as the horde of zombies and golems was about to surround Kirara-senpai...
Kirara-senpai firmly knocked both of her icy fists together.
A clear sound that of shattering glass resounded, and the space within a radius of about 10 meters around Kirara-senpai was painted white.
It was literally pure white. Even Kirara-senpai's figure momentarily disappeared from my sight.
There is a phenomenon known as a "whiteout," where snow or clouds turn the field of vision all white, which is exactly what happened.
Once the whiteout lifted, every single one of the monsters that had been trapped within were frozen solid.
It was an overwhelming cold. Even at this distance it chilled me to the bone.
If I'd been caught in it, I would have been added to the collection of ice statues, just as Kirara-senpai had said.
As she smashed the monsters now turned ice sculptures, Kirara-senpai began to engage the enemies just outside her Frozen Space as well.
So the Oni maiden is a master of ice!! Fascinating!! Be that the case, I shallー
The Guardian actually seemed rather amused by Kirara-senpai's technique. And as she was about to jump out to meet her...
...gunshots streaked by, quickly stopping her in her tracks.
The Guardian dodged the bullets with a swift movement, but the rags she was wearing were shredded to pieces by the impact of the bullets.
You ain't moving an inch from there! Good luck dealing with me while you're holding that little lady.
The Guardian groaned, but she didn't appear willing to toss Hebiko aside to take on Annreed.
That worked out better for me though.
Annreed was also biding her time, waiting for an opportunity to strike since Hebiko was still held in the Guardian's grasp.
Only Kirara-senpai's war cry resounded throughout the space as she continued to lay waste to the zombies and golems.
Even after freezing over half their numbers, it was still far too many for Kirara-senpai to take on by herself.
Chevalier listlessly pulled something from the breast of her outfit.
It was a small bottle. Inside it was yet another white liquid.
With a playful smile, Chevalier opened the lid of the bottle.
A mysterious white liquid, not horse sperm apparently, transitioned into a mist and spread its way through the air toward the monsters.
Needless to say, Kirara-senpai was still there. And Chevalier's white mist enveloped her along with the monsters.
Huh!? Wai-, what is this!? Eww, why is it so sour!?
It was sour apparently. Definitely smelled that way.
And as for the monsters now wrapped in this sour mist...
The zombies' bodies were melting away before our very eyes.

"""IN-... TRUDERS... DETEC-TED... EXTER-...MINATE...""
""INTRUD-... ERS, DE-... TECTED... EXTER-MINATE..."""
The golems on the other hand had either started fighting each other in confusion, or stood stock still as if they had fallen into a slumber.
I had no idea what she had done, but at any rate, the monsters were incapacitated in an instant.
Tis not exactly the same as abyssal research, is it?
With a subtle sigh, Chevalier closed the lid of the emptied bottle.
Hey! If you're that strong, you should've joined the fight from the start!
That's not the role Chevalier plays.
but Chevalier seemed to pay it little mind.
And what's with this sour stuff!? It's disgusting!
Some things are better left unsaid.
A single gunshot suddenly shattered the strangely relaxed atmosphere that had been developing.
You are an intriguing lot. You'd do well to follow after me.
The Guardian looked back at us and disappeared into the back of the altar with Hebiko under her arm.
But she wasn't running. This was clearly a ploy to lure us in.
But what else were we supposed to do with Hebiko and Shikanosuke still held captive?
Well we were not about to abandon our friends.
And so we resolutely charged ahead into the depths of the altar in pursuit of the Guardian.
